claim_updates.reason: Frozen decision_rule MEASUREMENT_INVALID trigger: only 4/8 co-occurring conditions have within-condition variance (std>0 for both signals), below the ≥6/8 validity gate. Root cause: session_invalidation drift produces constant behavioral signal (std=0.0) because API endpoints (/api/read, /api/write, /api/admin) only check JWT token and permissions, not session validity — session_state_changes is always 1, behavioral composite constant at 3.0 for all 120 session_invalidation samples. This is a measurement design flaw (audit V1_SESSION_INVALIDATION_ZERO_BEHAVIORAL_VARIANCE), not evidence against orthogonality. C3 orthogonality is UNTESTED: pooled r=0.0498 is confounded by 120 constant behavioral values; permutation p=0.449 fails p<0.05 conjunctive threshold. Descriptive observations preserved: (1) design fixes parent zero-imputation (unauthenticated /schema achieves 99.2% both>0); (2) pooled |r|=0.0498 is 12x lower than parent 0.593; (3) permission_boundary-only pooled r=0.051 (n=120, p=0.577) is directionally consistent with orthogonality but underpowered and non-significant. C-FRESHNESS remains EXPERIMENTAL; no validated second detection channel established.

next_question: Can a session_invalidation behavioral measurement that includes /session/status probing produce within-condition variance (std>0) on all co-occurring conditions, enabling a valid pooled Pearson r test of behavioral-structural orthogonality on the fixed co-occurring drift+noise design?
reason: MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen decision_rule: validity gate requires ≥6/8 co-occurring conditions with behavioral_std>0 AND structural_std>0; observed 4/8 (all permission_boundary conditions pass, all session_invalidation conditions fail with behavioral_std=0.0). The measurement design flaw is identified and fixable: session_invalidation is only observable via /session/status endpoint, not via API endpoint probing used in behavioral composite. C1-C2 and C4 pass, confirming the measurement infrastructure works for permission_boundary drift. The descriptive r=0.0498 is encouraging but the pooled test is confounded by 120 constant values and the permutation p=0.449 fails the conjunctive decision rule. The orthogonality hypothesis is untested, not falsified. No product decision is authorized. Claim ceiling bounded to Flask 3.1.3 + PyJWT 2.14.0 HS256 localhost, 2 drift patterns (permission_boundary works, session_invalidation broken), 4 noise patterns, deterministic mock.
